resources.string: This file is not a list of apps exported from Stamp or Obtainium.
Its address is on a local network. Add it by hand if it is yours.
This export from Stamp could not be read (%1$s). If it comes from a newer version of Stamp, update Stamp on this device and try again.
The file is larger than %1$d MiB, which is more than a list of apps takes, so Stamp did not read it.
That file is not there any more. Open the list of files again.
Only addresses that start with https:// are accepted.
That is not a web address Stamp can open. It should look like https://example.org/stamp-apps.json.
That address sends Stamp on to one that is not HTTPS, so nothing was fetched.
There is no file at that address. Check it for typing mistakes.
The server refused to hand out the file (it answered %1$d). Stamp sends no login with this request, so the file has to be readable by anyone who has the address.
The address could not be reached: %1$s
The address could not be reached. Check the connection and the address, then try again.
The server took more than a minute to send the file, so Stamp stopped waiting. Try again later.
What is at that address is not a list of apps exported from Stamp or Obtainium. The address has to lead to the file itself, not to a page that shows it.
This device has no shared storage that Stamp can write to.
The export could not be written: %1$s
The export could not be written.
